tools.name: search_prompts
tools.description: Search over 7,000 free, ready-to-copy AI prompts on fillprompt.com: image prompts (GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream and more), video prompts (Seedance, Gemini Omni, Grok Imagine and more) and text prompts (system prompts, agent prompts, roles). Returns titles, page URLs and short previews; call get_

tools.name: get_prompt
tools.description: Get the full text of one fillprompt.com prompt by its page URL or slug, with its fill-in slots, sample images or video, and credit to the original author. Fill the slots with the user's details before using the prompt, and keep the credit when you share it.

tools.name: random_prompt
tools.description: Get one fillprompt.com prompt picked at random, in full (the same shape as get_prompt), for requests like "surprise me" or "give me an idea for a poster" that have no search query. Narrow it with type, model or category.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: List the image categories, text prompt types and AI models on fillprompt.com, with how many prompts each has. Use the values with search_prompts.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_prompt" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Get the full text of one fillprompt.com prompt by its page URL or slug, with its fill-in slots, sample images or video, and credit to the original author. Fill …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_prompts, get_prompt · Public sink: get_prompt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_prompts, get_prompt · Public sink: get_prompt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
